description.en: HumanCLAW-Bench evaluates how VLMs make embodied decisions. Its 1,218 humanoid find-navigate-interact episodes span 41 indoor scenes, and low-level motor execution is factored out. Models are scored by success rate.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: The benchmark separates a VLM's action choices from motor-control failures, so it isolates embodied decision-making. The paper reports that the nine VLMs tested reach at most 16.8% success.
